fusions.name: Lunge From Still Water
fusions.desc: You lunge up to 4 tiles to the target. The bite deals 34 damage, is always a critical hit and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Death Roll
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. The roll deals 20 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and makes it 40% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Wait, Short Work
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 40% for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Sprung Jaw
fusions.desc: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your critical chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.
